title: Script table resize and redistribution
summary: Recovered Game.exe 0x4f0660 (416 bytes) as a readable State member with explicit accepted VM service boundaries. Preserves signed array-size comparisons, grow-before-hash initialization, ascending truncated-array migration with one-based integer keys, post-migration shrink allocation, descending old-node reinsertion, nil-sentinel identity, conditional flag clearing, error selection, x86 shift masking and final old-hash release. Original ECX=state, EDX=table and two caller-popped stack arguments are modeled by test-only GCC regparm(3) declarations with an unused EAX argument. Callers at 0x4f08dd and 0x4f43b1 confirm argument order and cleanup. Ten linked accepted references were byte-checked against immutable Game.exe. GCC behavioral runs passed and pinned MSVC2013 compiled implementation with O1, O2 and O2 /Oy-. Zero matching-source credit claimed.
test_description: test_main directly compares recovered member with original_script_table_resize. 680 core comparisons cover old/new sizes 0..12, old hash exponents 0..3, shift-masked exponents 32..35, empty nodes and numeric hash values redistributed into retained/new array slots. 3385 additional locally mapped cases cover hash requests 16/17/31/32/33, nil and high-bit nonnil tags, truncated-array migration, hash collisions and empty-hash sentinel ownership. Each comparison checks entire table/state/global/old-array/old-node/allocator-arena/event snapshots, MXCSR, surrounding guards, exact allocator pointer/size/order, untouched fields and independent byte accounting. Additional independent lookups assert retained and migrated values. Full local data-only fixtures at 0x99a41c (284 bytes nil/dummy/log table), 0x4f018c (16-byte dispatch) and 0xa063ec (4-byte zero) were checked against original evidence. Core-only link with unmapped fixture sections also passed; harness explicitly reports when full mapped comparisons are skipped.
known_limits: Only resize is recovered. VM allocation, initialization, lookup, insertion, garbage-collector behavior and error dispatch are explicit external Services dependencies, bound to accepted originals in test.cpp.

The genuine C++ member exposes portable service parameters and is not a drop-in replacement for the custom original register ABI. Original absolute nil/dummy identity tokens remain in the header and require translation in a Linux VM port.

Trusted linkers without the three fixed data mappings execute the 680 core differential cases and explicitly skip full hash comparisons. All 4065 comparisons passed locally with mapped original data fixtures.

Allocation failure, too-large allocation errors, nil/NaN error dispatch and nested rehash are not exercised. The accepted original error formatter and VM longjmp environment are not provided by these controlled tests; source preserves the observed branches without claiming exceptional-path validation.
Tests use numeric keys and ample new hash capacity; string/collectable-key GC barriers, nonnumeric equality and real VM integration are not validated here.

Negative sizes, enormous exponents/capacities, corrupted pointers and concurrent or adversarial callback mutation are outside test fixtures. The original signed comparisons and shift masking are retained rather than sanitized.
No byte-identical compiler output, matching credit or whole-game equivalence is claimed.
